projects.title: Recent projects
projects.intro: 4 flagship achievements — from Full-Stack SaaS to AI automation workflows, including medical sites and high-converting e-commerce stores.

sportbook.title: SportBook — Sports Reservation SaaS Platform
sportbook.problem: Reservation management via 3 Excel files + paper notebooks: data loss, duplicates, schedule conflicts and time-consuming administration for 3 sports complexes.
sportbook.solution: Multi-establishment SaaS platform (Laravel 10 + Sanctum + Laratrust for Admin/Manager/Player roles) with real-time scheduling, online payments, REST API and React analytical dashboard.

mediaflow.title: MediaFlow — Multimedia & AI Automation Pipeline
mediaflow.problem: Content creator: 15h/week manually editing, cropping, subtitling and publishing on 5 social platforms. Stuck publishing frequency, creative burnout.
mediaflow.solution: n8n orchestration + Python (FFmpeg) scripts + ChatGPT API: upload 1 source video → automatic generation of multi-format clips, AI subtitles, hashtags and scheduled publishing.

tantaoui.title: Dr. Tantaoui Medical Clinic — Site & Booking
tantaoui.problem: Medical clinic with no digital presence: phone-only booking (4h/day of calling), outdated information, and difficulty converting new patients.
tantaoui.solution: Modern medical showcase site (React + Tailwind) with specialty presentation, operating hours, geolocation map, secure contact form, and booking interface.

vasycom.title: VasyCom — Agency & Showcase / E-commerce Sites
vasycom.problem: SMEs with outdated showcase websites and non-converting e-commerce stores: 82% cart abandonment, slow loading speeds, and zero SEO visibility on Google.
vasycom.solution: Portfolio of custom sites (WordPress + Elementor Pro + WooCommerce): custom theme development, redesigned checkout funnel, on-page SEO, and Lighthouse scores of 95+.
